title: Slovak crime group modern slavery case (UK)
summary: A Slovak organised crime group recruited more than 60 Slovak nationals from the Košice and Prešov regions with promises of weekly salaries above EUR 400. In the UK, victims worked 14 hours a day, six days a week in restaurant kitchens and car washes for about EUR 25 a week and lived in poor conditions. After a UK–Slovak joint investigation team supported by Eurojust, five members were sentenced at Birmingham Crown Court to up to eight years for conspiracy to arrange human trafficking and compulsory labour.
